description: Carrefours Feux Sonores - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Location of sound tricolor lights. These lights can be vocal (the lights mention the name of the street) or simply sound (noise). Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Crossroads Feux Sonores – Tours Métropole Val de Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Its keywords include handicap, sig, mobilite, feu, feux-sonores, sonore. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2023-09-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
